dsh-opencode-go-quota 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。

posts.en:
dsh-opencode-go-quota is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-895f519af08692ae83c5.html
